context: Restrained trust-split redesign (Bybit/Stripe style) for Dynopay auth pages (/auth/login and /auth/register). Replaces the previous animated marketing reel (carousel, wallet count-up, coin marquee) with a calm, pure typographic + trust signals panel.
design_archetype: Restrained Trust Split (Swiss & High-Contrast / Tactical Minimalism)

layout_and_spacing.responsive_rule: The panel is strictly hidden on mobile/tablet (xs/sm/md) and rendered only at lg+ breakpoints. The form column handles mobile trust presentation separately via MobileTrustStrip.

section_1_eyebrow.name: Non-Custodial Security Pill
elements: Static gold indicator dot (7px diameter, NO pulsing animation)

section_2_hero_typography.name: Headline & Value Statement
section_2_hero_typography.headline: Institutional-grade crypto payments with zero custodial risk.
section_2_hero_typography.subheadline: Accept payments across 9 blockchains directly into your sovereign wallet. No balance locks, no intermediaries, transparent 0.5% settlement fees.

i18n_keys.subheadline: t('brandSubheadline', 'Accept payments across 9 blockchains directly into your sovereign wallet. Instant settlement, transparent fees.')

section_4_merchant_quote.author: The Dev Store

allowed_motion.entrance: authRise 560ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 120ms both (Single entrance reveal on component mount)
prohibited: NO counting up numbers or animated balances
NO pulsing glow dots or infinite keyframe loops
allowed_motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by setting animation: 'none'

instructions_to_main_agent: Remove all state/effects/intervals related to carousel scenes, balance count-up, flow dots, and animated coin marquee.
Replace the panel content with a purely static, calm typographic layout and 2x2 trust signals grid as outlined in the blueprint.
Ensure all copy uses i18n t() keys from the 'auth' namespace with explicit defaultValues.
Maintain root data-testid="auth-brand-panel" and assign data-testids to grid cards.
Apply exact color rules for light and dark modes according to the existing brand palette.
Keep single entrance animation (authRise) and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
